abhisajjana.p:
[Abhi+sajja+yu] (na,thī) CL=8 (A) Adherence,clinging ; Clinging by the power of love. (1) Clinging ,clinging by the power of anger. Abhisajjana(ti) [abhi+sajja+ṇe+yu, abhisajjanī in thī] 
Can cause to cling
a: အဘိသဇ္ဇန(န၊ထီ)
(က)ငြိကပ်ခြင်း၊ ချစ်-နှစ်သက်-သည်၏အစွမ်းအားဖြင့် ငြိကပ်ခြင်း။(၁)ငြိတွယ်ခြင်း၊ အမျက်ထွက်သည်၏အစွမ်းအားဖြင့် ငြိတွယ်ခြင်း။ abhisajjana အဘိသဇ္ဇန(တိ) [အဘိ+သဇ္ဇ+ဏေ+ယု၊ ထီ၌ အဘိသဇ္ဇနီ။] ငြိတွယ်စေတတ်သော။

[အဘိ+သဇ္ဇ+ဏေ+ယု၊ ထီ၌ အဘိသဇ္ဇနီ။]

abhisajjana：abhisajjana（na，thī）
အဘိသဇ္ဇန（န၊ထီ）
[abhi+sajja+yu]
[အဘိ+သဇ္ဇ+ယု]
C: abhisajjanā：f. [cf. abhisajjati] 不高興，執念（執著心強）. abhisajjanī f. 叱責.
P: Abhisajjana，（nt.-adj.） [abstr. fr. abhisajjati in meaning of abhisaṅga 2] only as adv. f. °nī Ep. of vācā scolding，abusing，cursing A.V，265 （para°）. Cp. next. （Page 70）

Abhisajjanā，（f.） [abstr. fr. abhisajjati，cp. abhisajjana] at Sn.49 evidently means “scolding，cursing，being in bad temper” （cp. abhisajjati），as its combn. with vāc’âbhilāpa indicates，but is expld. both by Nd2 & Bdhgh. as “sticking to，cleaving，craving，desire” （= taṇhā），after the meaning of abhisaṅga. See Nd2 89 & 107； SnA 98 （sineha-vasena），cp. also the compromise-expln by Bdhgh. of abhisajjati as kodha-vasena laggati （DA.I，257）. （Page 70）
U: ABHISAJJANA：[nt] sự dính líu，sự sân hận

abhisajjati.cp: abhi + sad + ya. is angry; is attached.
abhisajjati.p: [Abhi+sajja+a+ti] (kri) CL=8 (A) clinging; It clings by the power of love. (B) clings; It clings by the power of anger.
a: အဘိသဇ္ဇတိ(ကြိ)
(က)ငြိကပ်၏၊ ချစ်-နှစ်သက်-သည်၏အစွမ်းအားဖြင့် ငြိကပ်၏။(ခ)ငြိကပ်၏၊ အမျက်ထွက်သည်၏အစွမ်းအားဖြင့် ငြိတွယ်၏။

C: abhisajjati：[abhi-sañj] 變成不高興，發怒，生氣. opt. abhisaje； aor. abhisajji.
abhisajjati：[abhi + sad + ya] is angry； is attached.
S: abhisajjati：[abhi-sañj] 不機嫌となる，怒る. opt. abhisaje； aor. abhisajji.
D: Abhisajjati，（abhi + sad + ya），生气，附上，缚上。 ~sajji，【过】。（p36）
F: Abhisajjati，（abhi全面+sajjati执著），迁怒（直译：全面执著），附上，缚上。abhisajji，【过】。【3.单.祈】abhisaje。

abhisajjati：အဘိ-သဇ္ဇတိ （ကမ္မ） （အဘိ√သဉ္ဇ်+ယ）
အလွန် ကပ်ငြိ၏။ ငြိစွန်း၏။ အမျက်လို၏။ ရန်းငြိုးဖွဲ့၏။ ကျိန်ဆဲ၏။
DOP: abhisajjati pass. 3 sg. of abhisajati qv .
CPD: abhi-sajjati , pr. 3 sg. ( orig. pass, of prec, cf. sa. sajjate, Buddh.sa. abhi-ṣajyate, Av-ś 1286, 1 ), ( a ) Utt. to stick fast on, to linger in (gāme); ( b ) to take offence (+ kuppati); AN l 127, 1 (~ati + kuppati vyāpajjati patiṭṭhīyati ( or °tthīyati) kopañ ca dosañ ca appac- cayañ ca pātukaroti) ≠ AN ll 203, 16 foll. (quoted Sadd 96, 27 )≠AN lll 181, 10 foll. .≠Pp 30, 6 (= laggati, Pp-a) = 36, 26 ≠ MN lll 204, 19 foll.; 1 sg. n'evâbhisajjāmi na câpi kuppe, Ja lll 120, 15 * (= laggāmi, Ct. ) ; pot. 3 sg. ~eyya, Sn 929 (gāme ca nâbhisajjeyya; = gāme ca gihisaṃsaggâdīhi ~, Pj; cf. Nidd l 387, 1 ( a )) ; as to pot. 3 sg. med. ~etha, Ja V 175, 24 ' ( see abhi-sajjati ≠ DN lll 159, 8 (nâ°; = kuṭila-kaṇṭako viya tattha tattha mammaṃ ( so pt, S e ; E e tattha ca cammaώ) tudanto viya na laggi, Sv); 1 sg. ~sajjiṃ, AN ll 204, 34 (+ kuppiṃ, etc .); in f . ~itum (imāya appamattāya), DN l 91, 28 (= kodha-vasena laggituṃ, Sv).
NCP: pass. pr. 3 sg. sticks, is attached; is occupied; lingers. is offended, takes offense; is hostile See also: abhisajati
